name: Eight
description: The name Wrenn gives to Realmbreaker after bonding with it.

description_citations.text: "Wrenn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In a vision, Wrenn sings to find a lonely sapling in a lake of black oil and shields him with flaming trees.
timeline.quote: Flaming trees grow to the size of mountains

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Eight grows tall, and Wrenn names him Eight and resolves to bring him to Teferi.
timeline.quote: Hello, Eight , she says. Let's introduce you to Teferi.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Wrenn and Eight tear holes across planes and see the Phyrexian invasion everywhere.
timeline.quote: Fires churning in his belly, Eight reaches for new planes.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Wrenn and Eight get lost deliberately, tracing Teferi's magic to a hidden place out of time and finding him at a gathering of peaceful people.
timeline.quote: Among them—standing at the queen's side—is Teferi.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Wrenn realizes she can push planes together to bring Zhalfir into New Phyrexia, at the cost of herself and Eight, and asks Teferi to bring his friends.
timeline.quote: "Wait," she says. "Don't come alone. Bring your friends."

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Wrenn bonds with Realmbreaker, naming it Eight; together they locate Zhalfir and Teferi and swap New Phyrexia's location with Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: Wrenn was able to bond with Realmbreaker, whom she named Eight.

citation.text: "Wrenn", section "New Phyrexia's invasion of the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Wrenn and Eight open a portal to Zhalfir revealing New Phyrexia; Wezna is cautious but reassured by Teferi.
timeline.quote: When Wrenn and Eight opened a portal to her plane

citation.text: "Wezna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: But she does know she's got a fine new partner.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

pages_say.description: A shy sapling, the soul of the tree whose branches bridge planes, found by Wrenn in the dark within Realmbreaker; he grows under her song.
